scope: Independent proposed-plan review only; human approval and provider/IAM execution remain separate, not performed
reviewed_allow_boundary: Separate project custom role and one release-SA binding; no alteration to existing deployer role/WIF. New role has no document, secret, IAM-write, index update/delete or TTL permission. This describes the delta only; existing effective union of SA grants is not proved or restricted by this role.

findings.location: RETENTION-IAM-DELTA-PLAN.md Exact proposed diff and rollback
findings.finding: Collision stop checks different permissions/unexpected principals but does not explicitly preserve an existing conditional binding for the same SA. An additive unconditional binding could widen a pre-existing conditional grant; rollback member-only wording could remove unrelated conditional authority.
findings.required_change: Before asking human approval, specify exact expected binding shape/condition and collision stop on any unmatched existing condition. Never silently replace/widen a conditional grant. Rollback must target only root-added member+role+condition; delete owned role only after project/resource references proven absent, otherwise retain unused role.
findings.resolution: Fresh plan requires exact existing permission set and member/condition/binding shape, stops on mismatches and forbids unconditional grant over a conditional binding. Rollback targets only root-added exact tuple; owned role deletion requires absence of all project/resource bindings or retains unused role.

privilege_description.summary: Exact two permissions constrain new role to index metadata listing/creation; project scope allows other index definitions and cannot be described as IAM collection confinement. Immutable launcher limits are an independent application control.

metadata_applicability.summary: Fresh metadata records only direct project custom-role permission presence and etag. It correctly disclaims inherited/deny/resource-effective access. Role availability, support and effective permission must be rechecked; no redundant grant if access already exists.

concurrency_and_rollback.summary: Fresh plan preserves all conditions and uses exact shape collision stop plus etag/additive mutation; rollback removes only root-added exact tuple and retains unused role if all references cannot be proven absent.

deployment_readiness.summary: Human IAM approval and effective provider readback are absent by design. No IAM change performed; retention rollout still requires source gate, immutable indexes READY and exact Scheduler settings.

api_permission_limit: Release helper must use index list/create only. Individual index GET or operation GET must not be assumed covered; a changed permission need requires a new exact plan/effective-access review.

role_json.result: Exactly datastore.indexes.list and datastore.indexes.create; no other permission

provider_or_effective_access.reason: Read-only review assigned; metadata supplied by root, no independent provider query

iam_execution.reason: Plan still proposed and needs human approval after review

human_approval.reason: Root will ask approval only after this concrete plan review; this receipt authorizes no IAM execution.

review_cycles.temporal_limit: Initial finding came from a source read before root correction. First persisted input hashes were captured after that concurrent correction; they are not claimed as the pre-fix immutable artifact. Cycle2 freshly reread and verified exact current bytes.

review_cycles.evidence: Fresh exact plan reread resolves condition/rollback ambiguity; role remains exactly list/create; metadata unchanged; release owner confirms only LIST+POST index and LIST readiness operations.

limitations: This review does not prove permission support or all effective SA grants.
Project-scope create permits creation of other index specs if trusted tooling/identity were independently compromised.
Role rollback deletion must not harm other resource-level/concurrent bindings; retain role if absence cannot be proved.
provider_permission_contract: Release implementation owner confirms fixed index LIST+POST and polls LIST for READY, no individual index or operation GET. Scheduler GET permission observed in direct deployer role; effective access remains unverified.
